items.desc: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
items.readme: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) Run a managed Kubernetes service on your own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.** NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) provides the management plane that platform teams install to create and operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers. Each workload cluster has its own Kubernetes control plane, etcd and node pools. You operate the NVKE management plane; your customers use their clusters through the Kubernetes API and `kubectl`. Preview:** NVKE is available as a preview. APIs, configuration and behavior can change between releases, and we do not recommend NVKE for production workloads. See Preview status and known limitations. Get started · Documentation · Contribute ·

items.desc: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.readme: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries. No install:** `npx agent-browser open example.c

items.desc: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
items.readme: MuJoCo** stands for **Mu**lti-**Jo**int dynamics with **Co**ntact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind. MuJoCo has a C API and is intended for researchers and developers. The runtime simulation module is tuned to maximize performance and operates on low-level data structures that are preallocated by the built-in XML compiler.
